parsed.refutation_attempt: Checked the code for any OS command execution calls such as system(), exec(), popen(), or similar. Therefore, there is no path from the untrusted source (build_log) to an OS command execution. The vulnerability described would be a resource exhaustion issue (CWE‑789) rather than OS command injection.
